name: Damnation
text: Destroy all creatures. They can't be regenerated.

name: Incinerate
text: Incinerate deals 3 damage to any target. A creature dealt damage this way can't be regenerated this turn.
rulings: [{'date': '2007-07-15', 'text': 'Regeneration abilities that would affect that creature can still be activated; they just won’t do anything. The creature can’t be regenerated for any reason, even if an effect other than Incinerate would deal lethal damage to it or otherwise destroy it.'}]

name: Mana Tithe
text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1}.

name: Ponder
text: Look at the top three cards of your library, then put them back in any order. You may shuffle.\nDraw a card.
rulings: [{'date': '2021-03-19', 'text': 'If you choose to shuffle your library, that includes the three cards you just looked at and put back on top of it.'}]

name: Corrupt
text: Corrupt deals damage to any target equal to the number of Swamps you control. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.
rulings: [{'date': '2004-10-04', 'text': 'The swamps are counted on resolution.'}, {'date': '2010-08-15', 'text': "The amount of damage dealt to a creature is not bounded by its toughness, and the amount of damage dealt to a player is not bounded by that player's life total. For example, if Corrupt deals 6 damage to a 2/2 creature, you'll gain 6 life."}, {'date': '2010-08-15', 'text': 'The life you gain is equal to the damage dealt by Corrupt, not necessarily to the number of Swamps you control (if some or all of the damage is prevented, for example).'}, {'date': '2013-07-01', 'text': 'Corrupt counts any land you control with the subtype Swamp, not just ones named Swamp.'}]
